# open-ferry-ai-proxy

> open-ferry is a local AI proxy, a Rust port of CLIProxyAPI. On one port (8317 by default) it serves OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses, Claude Messages and the Gemini API, and passes each request on to an account or API key from its config: Codex and Claude sign-ins, the user's own Claude Code, Gemini, Vertex AI, xAI and OpenAI-compatible upstreams. It reads CLIProxyAPI's config.yaml and auth directory as they are. Pre-alpha: no release has been published yet.

Setting it up takes four steps, each in docs/agents.md: install it (the install scripts and the container image come with the first release; until then, build from source), write a config with `open-ferry init`, look it over with `open-ferry check`, and start it with `open-ferry -config PATH`. Clients send a client key from the config's `access.api-keys`; the management API at `/v0/management/` takes the config's `management.secret-key`. Both keys are secrets: keep them out of logs and commits.

## Docs

- [Setup for coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Loft-902-Co-LLC/open-ferry-ai-proxy/main/docs/agents.md): install, `open-ferry init` and `check`, where the config lives, pointing Codex, Claude Code and OpenAI-compatible clients at the proxy, and the management API
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Loft-902-Co-LLC/open-ferry-ai-proxy/main/README.md): what open-ferry does, building it from source, the dashboard, and its parity with CLIProxyAPI
- [The command line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Loft-902-Co-LLC/open-ferry-ai-proxy/main/docs/cli.md): `open-ferry init`, `check` and `service` in full
- [Migrating from CLIProxyAPI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Loft-902-Co-LLC/open-ferry-ai-proxy/main/docs/migrating-from-cliproxyapi.md): what carries over from a CLIProxyAPI setup and what doesn't
- [The config template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Loft-902-Co-LLC/open-ferry-ai-proxy/main/config.example.yaml): every setting, with comments and commented examples of each provider

## APIs

- [The dashboard API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Loft-902-Co-LLC/open-ferry-ai-proxy/main/docs/dashboard-api.md): `/open-ferry/api/v1/`, for usage, request-log search and ready-made client setups, and how both it and the management API check the management key
- [UPSTREAM.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Loft-902-Co-LLC/open-ferry-ai-proxy/main/UPSTREAM.md): what was ported from CLIProxyAPI v8.0.15, including the management API routes, and every deliberate difference
